ADMIT-10.name: NOT_A_PASSWORD
ADMIT-10.description: Raised when what was offered at the door is not a password.

ADMIT-11.name: KEY_IN_THE_CLEAR
ADMIT-11.description: Raised when a key arrived from another machine over a connection its pin does not verify.

ADMIT-12.name: NOT_FOR_A_KEY
ADMIT-12.description: Raised when a key asked for something its scope does not reach.

ADMIT-4.name: NOT_ADMITTED
ADMIT-4.description: Raised when a request carried no token, session or key this run admits.

ADMIT-5.name: ELSEWHERE
ADMIT-5.description: Raised when a request said it came from somewhere this server is not.

ADMIT-6.name: NOT_YOURS
ADMIT-6.description: Raised when an account asked for something that is not its to ask for.

ADMIT-7.name: UNCONFIRMED
ADMIT-7.description: Raised when the media server could not say whether an account is still one.

ADMIT-8.name: NOT_THE_PASSWORD
ADMIT-8.description: Raised when the password offered at the door was wrong, or none is set.

ADMIT-9.name: TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS
ADMIT-9.description: Raised when the door has been given too many wrong passwords lately.

ASK-1.name: NO_SUCH_ACTION
ASK-1.description: Raised where no action goes by the name that was asked for.

ASK-10.name: WRONG_METHOD
ASK-10.description: Raised where an endpoint was asked with a method it does not answer.

ASK-11.name: NOT_A_KEY_REQUEST
ASK-11.description: Raised where the body of a mint is not a key's name, scope, purpose and the password.

ASK-12.name: NOT_AN_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY
ASK-12.description: Raised where an action's `Idempotency-Key` is not one to 255 visible characters, or is given more than once.

ASK-13.name: IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED
ASK-13.description: Raised where an `Idempotency-Key` already sent with one action and its arguments is sent with another.

ASK-2.name: MISSING_ARGUMENT
ASK-2.description: Raised where an action was not given an argument it needs.

ASK-3.name: UNRECOGNISED_ARGUMENT
ASK-3.description: Raised where an argument was given a value that names nothing.

ASK-4.name: UNWANTED_ARGUMENT
ASK-4.description: Raised where an action was given an argument its command has nowhere to put.

ASK-5.name: ARGUMENTS_TOGETHER
ASK-5.description: Raised where two arguments that each name a different request arrived together.

ASK-6.name: NOT_ARGUMENTS
ASK-6.description: Raised where the body of an action is not arguments it can read.

ASK-7.name: NO_SUCH_JOB
ASK-7.description: Raised where a job was asked about that this run did not start.

ASK-8.name: NOT_AN_ANSWER
ASK-8.description: Raised where the body of a setup step is not an answer it can read.

ASK-9.name: NO_ENDPOINT
ASK-9.description: Raised where a path under the endpoints is one no endpoint answers.

GONE-2.name: ANOTHER_READING
GONE-2.description: Raised when an agreement names a reading of this machine that is not the one standing now.

MIGRATE-1.name: OFFER_MOVED
MIGRATE-1.description: Raised when a replacement was agreed to for an offer that is not the one standing now.

PLUGIN-10.name: NOTHING_TO_REMOVE
PLUGIN-10.description: Nothing by that name is installed on this machine.

PLUGIN-11.name: NOTHING_TO_UPDATE
PLUGIN-11.description: Nothing by that id is installed, so there is no version to replace.

PLUGIN-12.name: STUCK
PLUGIN-12.description: The version installed would not come off, so nothing else was touched.

PLUGIN-13.name: ANSWERED
PLUGIN-13.description: Raised when a plugin's service would answer on a label another plugin's already does.

PLUGIN-14.name: TWO_SOURCES
PLUGIN-14.description: Raised when a plugin is installed from a source other than the one its name is already installed from.

PLUGIN-15.name: SOURCE_OFF
PLUGIN-15.description: Raised when a plugin is named from a git source and fetching from one is switched off.

PLUGIN-16.name: UNFETCHED
PLUGIN-16.description: Raised when a git source could not be reached or would not hand over a revision.

PLUGIN-17.name: NO_REVISION
PLUGIN-17.description: Raised when a git source holds no branch, tag or commit by the name given.

PLUGIN-18.name: CATALOGUE_OFF
PLUGIN-18.description: Raised when a plugin is installed by name and asking the catalogue is switched off.

PLUGIN-19.name: CATALOGUE_UNREACHABLE
PLUGIN-19.description: Raised when the catalogue's index or its signature could not be fetched.

PLUGIN-2.name: UNREADABLE
PLUGIN-2.description: The source names no plugin this build can read.

PLUGIN-20.name: SIGNATURE_UNVERIFIED
PLUGIN-20.description: Raised when the catalogue's index has no signature, one that does not verify, or none this build carries a key to check.

PLUGIN-21.name: CATALOGUE_UNREADABLE
PLUGIN-21.description: Raised when the catalogue's index verified and is not one this build reads.

PLUGIN-22.name: NOT_CATALOGUED
PLUGIN-22.description: Raised when the catalogue holds no plugin by the name given.

PLUGIN-23.name: NOT_AS_REVIEWED
PLUGIN-23.description: Raised when what the catalogue's origin served is not what the catalogue reviewed.

PLUGIN-24.name: SPELLED_ALIKE
PLUGIN-24.description: Raised when a plugin's service would be named, where lemonfiber keeps what a service holds, as another installed plugin's service already is.

PLUGIN-25.name: PLUGIN_OFFER_MOVED
PLUGIN-25.description: Raised when an install, an update or a removal answers an offer that was read against a plugin, a stack or a record that has since moved.

PLUGIN-26.name: UNAPPROVED
PLUGIN-26.description: Raised when a value a recipe would carry to a destination was not approved as itself, or an approval names a pair the recipe does not carry.

PLUGIN-27.name: ANOTHER_PLUGIN
PLUGIN-27.description: Raised when the source an update names holds a different plugin from the one it was asked to update.

PLUGIN-28.name: OCCUPIED
PLUGIN-28.description: Raised when a plugin's service would take a name, a port or a label something already on this machine holds: a service of the stack or of the operator's overlay, another plugin's port, or a site in the proxy's live configuration.

PLUGIN-29.name: CATALOGUE_REPLACED
PLUGIN-29.description: Raised when the catalogue's index verifies and is older than the newest one this machine has verified.

PLUGIN-3.name: REFUSED
PLUGIN-3.description: The manifest is read and this build refuses what it declares.

PLUGIN-30.name: NEWEST_UNKEPT
PLUGIN-30.description: Raised when the record of the newest catalogue index this machine verified cannot be read or written.

PLUGIN-31.name: SCHEME_REFUSED
PLUGIN-31.description: Raised when a git source is named over a transport other than https, before anything is asked of it.

PLUGIN-32.name: ADDRESS_REFUSED
PLUGIN-32.description: Raised when a git source's host is, or stands for, an address on this machine or on a network of its own: loopback, private, link-local or unspecified.

PLUGIN-33.name: HEADER_NAMED
PLUGIN-33.description: Raised when a recipe substitutes a value into a header's name, which is a fixed identifier of the protocol and written out; the manifest's every other fault is listed beside it.

PLUGIN-34.name: INPUT_UNMATCHED
PLUGIN-34.description: Raised when a recipe of the act asks the operator for a value that was not given, or a value was given that no recipe of the act asks for.

PLUGIN-35.name: CALL_REFUSED
PLUGIN-35.description: Raised when a recipe's call was not sent because its host stands for an address not out on the internet; the install or update was put back.

PLUGIN-36.name: STEP_FAILED
PLUGIN-36.description: Raised when a recipe's step failed any other way — nothing answered, the answer was not the one it expects, a capture found nothing, or the answer was larger than a recipe reads; the install or update was put back.

PLUGIN-37.name: PATH_NOT_PLAIN
PLUGIN-37.description: Raised when a recipe's call path is not a plain absolute path; the manifest's every other fault is listed beside it.

PLUGIN-38.name: VALUE_WITHHELD
PLUGIN-38.description: Raised when a recipe's call was not sent because a value it carries may not go where it was going: not where its pairs say, not back to the service a credential belongs to, or outside without its approval; the install or update was put back.

PLUGIN-4.name: UNRECORDED
PLUGIN-4.description: The record of what is installed cannot be read.

PLUGIN-6.name: NOWHERE
PLUGIN-6.description: There is no stack on this machine to put a plugin's container in.

PLUGIN-7.name: UNWRITABLE
PLUGIN-7.description: A directory or a document the install decided on would not land.

PLUGIN-8.name: UNRECORDABLE
PLUGIN-8.description: The wiring went down and the record of what is installed did not.

PLUGIN-9.name: UNPROVED
PLUGIN-9.description: The plugin's own service would not start, so nothing about it could be proved.

READ-1.name: UNWANTED
READ-1.description: Raised where a read was given a parameter its answer has nowhere to put.

READ-10.name: TOO_MANY_AT_ONCE
READ-10.description: Raised where more holdings were asked for than one read answers with.

READ-11.name: NO_SUCH_GROUP
READ-11.description: Raised where a diagnosis was narrowed to a group or check that is not one.

READ-12.name: NO_SUCH_REMOVAL
READ-12.description: Raised where a removal was named that is none of the four there are.

READ-13.name: NO_UPDATE_OBJECT
READ-13.description: Raised where moving forward was asked about and neither stack nor self named.

READ-14.name: NOT_A_LINE_COUNT
READ-14.description: Raised where how many log lines to begin with is not a number within the ceiling.

READ-15.name: NOT_A_CHOICE
READ-15.description: Raised where a parameter that takes a yes or a no is neither true nor false.

READ-16.name: MEMBER_AND_DEFAULTS
READ-16.description: Raised where a household read named a member and asked for the household's defaults as well.

READ-2.name: REPEATED
READ-2.description: Raised where a parameter carrying one value was given more than once.

READ-3.name: NO_SUCH_READ
READ-3.description: Raised where no read goes by the name that was asked for.

READ-4.name: NO_TERM
READ-4.description: Raised where a trace was asked for and named nothing to follow.

READ-5.name: NOT_A_SEASON
READ-5.description: Raised where the season to narrow a trace to is not a number.

READ-6.name: NO_SETTING
READ-6.description: Raised where a setting was asked for by an empty name.

READ-7.name: NO_MEMBER
READ-7.description: Raised where a household member was asked for by an empty name.

READ-8.name: NO_SHELF_WITHOUT_A_MEMBER
READ-8.description: Raised where a shelf was asked for and nobody was named whose it is.

READ-9.name: NOT_A_COUNT
READ-9.description: Raised where how many holdings to answer with is not a whole number.

REPAIR-1.name: STALE
REPAIR-1.description: Raised when consent was given for an offer that no longer stands.

RESTORE-11.name: MOVED_ON
RESTORE-11.description: Raised when consent was given for a listing that no longer stands.

SERVE-6.name: UNRENDERABLE
SERVE-6.description: Raised when an answer could not be rendered.

SERVE-7.name: NO_JOB_NAME
SERVE-7.description: Raised when this machine will not supply the randomness a job is named with.

SERVE-8.name: UNANSWERED
SERVE-8.description: Raised when an action's work ended before it had an answer to give.

SPACE-6.name: ANOTHER_OFFER
SPACE-6.description: Raised when an agreement names an offer that is not the one standing now.

STACK-1.name: STACK_UNREADABLE
STACK-1.description: Raised when a stack directory holds no readable manifest.

STACK-10.name: STACK_UNASSEMBLED
STACK-10.description: Raised when a manifest's files are not laid out as the contract says.

STACK-2.name: STACK_UNUSABLE
STACK-2.description: Raised when a manifest is readable and this build cannot use it.

STACK-3.name: STACK_NOT_EMBEDDED
STACK-3.description: Raised when the embedded stack is not intact.

STACK-4.name: STACK_NOT_SET_UP
STACK-4.description: Raised when lemonfiber has nowhere to write the stack.

STACK-5.name: STACK_NOT_WRITTEN
STACK-5.description: Raised when the stack could not be written to disk.

STACK-6.name: STACK_INVALID
STACK-6.description: Raised when a manifest parses and breaks the contract.

STACK-7.name: STACK_MALFORMED
STACK-7.description: Raised when a manifest is not TOML at all.

STACK-8.name: STACK_UNRECOGNISED
STACK-8.description: Raised when a manifest declares names this build does not know.

STACK-9.name: STACK_NEEDS_NEWER
STACK-9.description: Raised when a stack names a newer lemonfiber than the one running.

WIRE-1.name: NO_SUCH_FILLER
WIRE-1.description: A capability was named that no service in this stack provides.

WIRE-2.name: CANNOT_FILL
WIRE-2.description: The service named cannot do the thing it was asked to fill.

WIRE-3.name: NOTHING_ASKS
WIRE-3.description: Nothing in this stack asks for the capability, so a choice would change nothing.

WIRE-4.name: CHOICE_UNWRITABLE
WIRE-4.description: The setting recording the choice could not be written.

WIRE-5.name: WIRING_MOVED
WIRE-5.description: Raised when a choice answers an offer that was read against a wiring that has since moved.

WIRE-6.name: UNREASONABLE
WIRE-6.description: Raised when the reason given for a choice is longer than a reason may be, or holds a line break or another control character.
